_note: Extra RSS or Atom feeds for scripts/collect.mjs, on top of the built-in list. The source scout job adds and retires entries here (never in code). Each: name, tier (gov, vendor or news), https url, optional filter (true keeps only items that mention a cyber topic in any of the languages the collector knows; use it for broad feeds), optional lang (ISO code) and region, added (date) and why. A name listed in retired is not collected, built-in or not: retire a dead feed, one whose robots.txt now disallows it, or one on the watch list that still has nothing useful when its review date comes. watch: feeds that work but showed little yield; each has the evidence (from data/leads and data/runs closures; the lead files begin on 2026-11-18, so the first audit saw only 2.5 days) and a review date.
